title: App API and teacher-site evidence inventory
purpose: Inventory existing app-related reverse-engineering evidence and canonical route candidates; identify what is needed for a verified app API map.

included: Existing sanitized app/site structural artifacts under research/backend-map and the linked sanitized remote-source inventory.
App-related route entries discovered through the deterministic harness route query.
excluded: Protected config/ and data/ contents, credentials, raw student records, and student identifiers.
Network requests, browser sessions, app traffic, and production data.
Claims that teacher-site shells or route declarations establish a complete native-app API.

provenance.evidence: Source-level app-adjacent declarations and operation risks; explicitly says no live native-app proof.
Dated bounded teacher-site page shells and inspected inline JavaScript/form structure; no app action replay or student-level app state verification.
Source and prior-live review of pre-study/app read gaps; no selected-student submission, grading, video, or stable join verified.
Canonical operation records, effects, join-key names, and probe limits. The harness result was filtered by route ID and app/pre-study concepts; the registry file was not edited.

Sanitized source inventory says native-command bridges such as LecturePlay and CreateWorkBook do not establish direct student-app backend access; the copied local SQLite schema is not the academy production database.
Current map boundary states teacher-site shells do not verify the native app API, selected-student submissions/grading, or app-to-site joins.

route_discovery.interpretation: These entries include teacher-site shells, source-declared operations, historical candidates, and unknown-effect candidates. Presence in the registry does not imply live app access or permission to probe.

app_only_unknowns: Native app host/base URL, API version, endpoint inventory, and authentication/session contract.
App account/student identity and its stable mapping to the LMS student key.
Assigned course edition, volume, unit, problem range, and exact lesson occurrence relation.
Submission/upload identifiers, event timestamps, pagination, retries, and server acknowledgment semantics.
Problem attempts and automatic grading status, score, and grading timestamp.

devtools_assessment.can_site_devtools_help: Yes, for requests made by the teacher website in that browser session. It can reveal browser-visible paths, methods, content types, request field names, response field names, pagination, and timing for actions actually performed there.
devtools_assessment.boundary: Site DevTools cannot reveal native-app-only traffic unless the app action is actually executed through an inspectable browser surface or the app is separately instrumented through an authorized device debugging/proxy setup. Shared backend claims do not make native requests visible in the site browser.
devtools_assessment.current_session_result: No browser tool or authenticated browser tab was available for this inventory pass. Existing dated app-live evidence records fixed teacher-site shells and inline JavaScript inspection only; it did not submit searches, invoke app bridges, or capture app traffic.
devtools_assessment.handling: Any future capture should be owner-provided or made through an authorized session, with credentials, cookies, authorization headers, student values, media URLs, and answer content removed before persistence. Keep only the minimum field/route contract evidence needed.

next_inputs_needed_for_verified_app_api_.input: A sanitized DevTools HAR or equivalent request/response field inventory from the actual app workflow, if that workflow runs in an inspectable browser.
If native-only, app/platform/build version plus an owner-authorized device capture method and a redacted request contract; no credential extraction or broad traffic collection.
A synthetic or owner-approved identity/lesson fixture with exact expected joins, supplied as opaque placeholders rather than raw student records.
needed_to_answer: app identity to LMS identity mapping

next_inputs_needed_for_verified_app_api_.input: Current source or API documentation for the app service, including schema/version and explicit read/write semantics, if available.

status: Inventory complete; a verified native app API map remains blocked on app-origin request/source evidence and stable student/lesson joins.
